services.desc: are based on a single-family unit of 2 adults and children. Additional guests ages 18 years and older will be charged $10 per person, per night. Check-in time is 3 pm, and check-out time is 2 pm unless other arrangements are authorized. Monthly camping is a short-term lease for at least 30 consecutive days. It is based on availability. An application may be printed from the campground website, www.millesonscampground.com. Once submitted, your application will be reviewed, and you will be contacted about preferred dates and available sites. Seasonal camping is a long-term lease for the full 6-month camping season. blurb: We are a seasonal, family campground that is off the beaten path. Our campground is situated 3 miles down a country dirt road, on a working livestock farm, along a bend in the South Branch of the Potomac River. Milleson's offers a variety of sites for overnight and weekend camping, as well as seasonally leased sites and monthly leases upon availability.
